seo.title: Valencia Dentistry | Dr. Nuriel Lavi, Santa Clarita
seo.description: Holistic, one-on-one dentistry in Valencia, Santa Clarita. Dr. Nuriel Lavi offers implants, veneers, Invisalign and same-day crowns. New patients welcome.

sections.heading: Dentistry that feels calm, personal and thorough.
sections.lead: Dr. Nuriel Lavi sees every patient himself, at every visit. Holistic, integrative care with modern technology, in a quiet office on Tourney Road.

sections.heading: What's bringing you in?
sections.lead: Choose what's on your mind and we'll show you where to start. Or call (661) 254-5200 and talk it through with our front desk.

options.label: Missing teeth
options.title: Replacing one tooth, several, or a full arch
options.text: Dr. Lavi plans every implant on a 3D CBCT scan, so you know how much bone you have and what your real options are before anything begins. If an implant isn't the right fit, a fixed bridge may be.

links.label: All-on-4 implants
links.description: A full arch on four implants

links.label: Bone grafting
links.description: When there isn't enough bone yet

options.label: Chipped or worn teeth
options.title: Repairing chips, cracks and worn edges
options.text: Small chips can often be repaired with tooth-colored bonding. Larger breaks or worn-down teeth usually need a crown, which we design and make in house, often in a single visit. Veneers can reshape several front teeth at once.

links.label: Veneers
links.description: Shape and color for front teeth

options.label: Crooked or crowded teeth
options.title: Straightening without metal braces
options.text: Invisalign clear aligners are planned from an iTero digital scan, with no impression trays. How long it takes depends on your bite; Dr. Lavi gives you a realistic estimate at your consultation.

options.label: Jaw pain or headaches
options.title: Relief for a sore, clicking or tired jaw
options.text: Morning jaw soreness, clicking or tension headaches can come from the jaw joint or from grinding at night. We start with a careful look at your bite and joint, then talk through options such as a custom night guard.

options.label: Nervous about the dentist
options.title: Going at your pace
options.text: You'll see Dr. Lavi at every visit, and nothing happens without an explanation first. Tell us how you feel at the start; sedation options are available when appropriate.

links.label: Your first visit
links.description: What happens at your first exam

options.label: Toothache or a broken tooth
options.title: In pain right now
options.text: Call (661) 254-5200 as early as you can. Same-day appointments are often available for pain, swelling or a broken tooth, Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm.

links.label: Tooth extractions
links.description: When a tooth can't be saved

sections.heading: Meet Dr. Nuriel Lavi, DDS
body: Dr. Lavi leads Valencia Dentistry on Tourney Road. He sees every patient himself, at every visit, and he listens before he recommends anything.

His plans start with your long-term health and your comfort: modern imaging, biocompatible materials, and prevention before quick fixes. You get plain explanations, honest priorities and an unhurried visit.
points: One dentist at every visit, no handoffs
Crowns made in house, often same day

sections.heading: What happens at your first visit
sections.lead: No rush and no surprises. Here is exactly what to expect when you come in for your new patient exam.

steps.title: Before you arrive
steps.text: We check your PPO benefits ahead of time. Park free on site; Suite 240 is on the second floor, and the building has an elevator.

steps.title: A short health history
steps.text: Arrive a few minutes early with a photo ID, your insurance card and a list of the medications you take.

steps.title: Digital X-rays
steps.text: Low-radiation digital X-rays show what can't be seen in the chair, and appear on screen right away.

steps.title: An unhurried exam with Dr. Lavi
steps.text: Teeth, gums and bite, plus an oral cancer screening. He explains what he sees as he goes.

steps.title: A plan you can take home
steps.text: Your options, what is urgent and what can wait, a written estimate, and time for every question.

sections.note: Your first visit includes a comprehensive exam and X-rays.

sections.heading: The equipment, and what it means for you
sections.lead: Tap or hover over each one to see why it matters at your visit.

items.title: 3D CBCT imaging
items.text: A three-dimensional view of teeth, bone and nerves.
items.forYou: Implants and wisdom teeth are planned with fewer surprises.

items.title: iTero digital scanning
items.text: Digital impressions instead of trays of putty.
items.forYou: No gag-inducing impression material, and you see your scan on screen.

items.title: Digital X-rays
items.forYou: Quicker answers in the chair, with less exposure.

items.title: Crowns made in house
items.text: Crowns designed and made here in the office.
items.forYou: Many crowns are finished in one visit, without a temporary.

items.title: PRF therapy
items.text: Platelet-rich fibrin made from a small sample of your own blood.
items.forYou: Used after extractions, grafting and implants to support healing.

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.forYou: You see exactly what Dr. Lavi sees before you decide anything.
